"The Energy Node at the Connection of the Scorpion Tail and the Lion Body presents a special balanced structure. It looks like a key bridge of two fused bloodlines, does this imply that the Scorpion is not a product of natural evolution but of some ancient bloodline modulation?"
This question even made Hayek look twice, clearly showing that Ron’s understanding had already surpassed the realm of an ordinary apprentice, with a flair akin to a mature Bloodline Modifier.
The attitude of the other contestants shifted from initial surprise to admiration, even Holt, who was usually calm, occasionally nodded in recognition of Ron’s insights.
"Your understanding of extraordinary biology far surpasses that of all your peers, Apprentice Ralph."
As the dissection was about to conclude, Hayek commented, his tone unintentionally carrying a hint of appreciation:
"This is not just superficial knowledge but an intuition that penetrates the essence, your level of Bloodline Modulation must be quite high?"
"Thank you for the compliment, sir, it’s just because of some work in the workshop that I’m more familiar with these," Ron humbly responded, maintaining a calm exterior while internally he felt the opportunity for a breakthrough in skills.
The accumulation of Extraordinary Biological Skills had finally reached the critical point.
An unprecedented sense of comprehension burst forth in his heart, as if a fog had lifted, bathed in sunlight.
Fragmented points of knowledge at this moment interconnected, forming a complete, systemic cognitive network.
This understanding is not simply memory or imitation, but an insight emerging from within.
It’s as if suddenly mastering a new language, able to fluently read previously incomprehensible code.
[Extraordinary Biological Experience Points +1]
[Breakthrough! Extraordinary Biology (Novice 50/50) → Extraordinary Biology (Proficient 1/100)]
[Acquired Additional Trait: Insight (able to more intuitively understand internal structures of extraordinary beings and energy flow patterns)]
This trait allows him to clearly comprehend the construction principles of extraordinary beings, energy circulation mechanisms, adaptability changes, and even the fusion traits between different races.
Ron’s heartbeat involuntarily accelerated, but his facial expression remained one of calm contemplation, not revealing any change to anyone.
He immediately attempted to activate this newly acquired trait, focusing his attention on the Scorpion’s corpse.
The internal structure of the Scorpion presented a complete three-dimensional model in his mind.
Every detail was exceedingly vivid, including those energy channels and microscopic structures invisible to the naked eye.
He could even "see" the traces of energy flow that had become stagnant, understanding their operational methods and mutual influences during life.
What delighted him further was that this "Insight" trait formed a perfect complement with "Tracing."
Tracing allowed him to identify the bloodline origins and evolutionary paths of creatures, while Insight enabled him to understand their internal structures and energy operation methods.
The combination of the two could nearly construct a complete extraordinary biological map, holding invaluable significance for his bloodline modulation research!
"This is the last part and also the most valuable part."
Hayek carefully extracted a purple-black crystal from deep within the Scorpion’s chest cavity, its surface covered with fine lightning-like patterns, with a faint light flickering inside:
"The Energy Core of the Scorpion, storing all its life information and energy essence. Among Abyssal creatures, this core is often its most precious part, possessing extremely high value for bloodline research."
Ron gazed at the crystal and the various extraordinary organs that had been dissected, finding them quite intriguing as he sensed that these Abyssal biological materials would greatly benefit his bloodline research.
And after the anatomy guide was completely concluded, the Vice President announced to the contestants:

chapters.title: Chapter 236 - 168: "Insight" Trait (3)
chapters.content: Enable JavaScript and cookies to continue

chapters.title: Chapter 237 - 169: Its "Gaze
chapters.content:
Chapter 237: Chapter 169: Its "Gaze
Turning back for a glance, it was Soron watching him with a subtle expression.
In that gaze, there seemed to be scrutiny, along with a hint of elusive interest, much like an art connoisseur appreciating a magnificent piece.
He respectfully bowed to the mentors and then stepped away from the Central Tower.
On the road back to the workshop, as evening deepened, the ominous aura of the Black Mist Jungle grew even more intense.
From afar, strange cries echoed intermittently, chilling to the bone.
Yet these could not disturb Ron’s thoughts.
"The Scorpion bloodline indeed has unique value."
He was assessing today’s gains in his mind:
"The dual heart system can separately handle material energy and magic energy, which offers significant advantages in the abyss environment; meanwhile, the distributed neural network provides it with strong survival resilience, maintaining basic functions even if severely damaged."
But at the same time, he did not overlook the potential risks:
"However, the traits of abyssal creatures often come with some form of ’pollution’ or ’erosion,’ necessitating adequate isolation measures to ensure that useful traits are extracted without introducing harmful factors."
This has always been Ron’s attitude towards research. The thirst for knowledge never ceases, but each exploration must be founded on experimentation.
As the sunlight gradually waned, Ron returned to the workshop.
"Master!" Lily approached quickly, her eyes full of concern:
"Did everything go well? I heard there was some dispute over the final rewards of the combat meeting..."
"Master is back!"
Dale bounced excitedly, her eyes sparkling with curiosity:
"Did you get the prize? Did you get the prize?"
Ron smiled faintly, gently ruffling Dale’s silver hair:
"Everything went smoothly. Not only did I get all the rewards, but I also acquired some precious research materials."
He briefly recounted today’s experiences and gains to the two, but omitted details that might be overly technical.
"Moreover,"
His tone carried an unmistakable anticipation, "I’ve obtained this."
Ron carefully took out a black ebony box containing the Stand-In Puppet, displaying this precious abyssal treasure to the two.
"Wow! What a strange puppet!"
Dale curiously leaned closer but did not reach out to touch, only widened her eyes to examine closely.
She had been repeatedly taught not to touch potentially dangerous extraordinary items casually, even when driven by curiosity.
"Those eyes..." the Little Sea Siren murmured, her voice tinged with instinctive fear:
"It seems... like it’s looking at us..."
Lilia’s expression was more cautious, her brow slightly furrowed, her lips pressed into a thin line:
"Is this the abyssal treasure that can create stand-ins? It looks somewhat... ominous. This aura reminds me of those cursed doll stories."
Indeed, even within the wooden box, that green-gray puppet exuded a sinister and eerie presence, as if carrying whispers and memories from the Great Abyss.
Especially those dark red gemstone eyes, even in a dormant state, seemed as though they were constantly observing everything around.
"Don’t worry,"
Ron reassured:
"Items from the abyss often carry a certain unsettling aura, but that is mostly superficial; what’s truly important is their function."
He closed the lid, and that eerie aura immediately diminished significantly, as if resealed.
"However, specific research and activation need to be conducted in a more secure environment. I’ll handle this in the laboratory’s isolation array."
His gaze swept over the workshop, already planning the sequence of his next actions:
First, to study the usage method of the Stand-In Puppet, which is crucial for realizing his future ’Melting Furnace Concept’;
If there is spare time, utilize the knowledge and samples gained from this anatomy guide to further perfect bloodline modulation research;
Finally, and most importantly, make every effort to break through the Meditation Technique to reach the level of an Advanced Apprentice, which is a key step towards a higher realm.
"Lilia, help me prepare some mental fortification potions tonight, especially ’Awakening’ and ’Spiritual Shield.’
Ron skillfully distributed tasks.
Lilia nodded, accustomed to not questioning the master’s arrangements at every step:
"I’ll prepare them right away. You still have three bottles of ’Awakening’ and two bottles of ’Spiritual Shield’ in the cupboard."
Ron then turned to Dale, his voice softened:
"Little one, rest well today. Tomorrow I will prepare some new ’food’ for you, to better help you digest the energy absorbed before. This time’s ’food’ will include some special ingredients, so its taste might be a bit peculiar."
Dale nodded happily, her large sapphire eyes full of anticipation:
"I will be good! Master’s ’food’ is always the best tasting, even if the flavor is strange, it doesn’t matter!"
Her trust in Ron was so pure, like the affection of a stream for its riverbed, unconditional and without reason.
After arranging everything, Ron went to the laboratory on the second floor of the workshop, placing the Stand-In Puppet carefully in the center of the specifically designed array.
The ritual arrays inside and outside the workshop were all activated by him.
Rune glows shimmered like fireflies in the dark, weaving an invisible barrier that completely isolated the internal energy fluctuations from the outside world.
Ron sat cross-legged in the center of the laboratory, before him was the Stand-In Puppet emitting an eerie aura, now taken out from the black ebony box and placed on a specially designed silver base.

chapters.title: Chapter 238 - 169: His "Gaze" (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 238: Chapter 169: His "Gaze" (2)
Inside the room, the candlelight was weak and flickering, as if it could be extinguished at any moment.
"Ready."
He took a deep breath, his gaze fixed on the puppet’s dark red gemstone eyes.
Through the ability of [Extraordinary Recognition], he had roughly understood the workings and activation method of this Abyssal Treasure.
Like other rare and ancient items, activation usually required his blood as a medium, and only his blood was effective.
But unlike the previous Transformer skin and Pocket Watch, the Stand-In Puppet also required the user to actively infuse a portion of consciousness or soul to complete the true binding.
This was a more in-depth and dangerous process than a mere blood connection, requiring extreme caution.
Ron took out a small silver dagger and gently made a small cut on his index finger.
Bright red blood oozed along the wound, like a string of tiny pearls.
He gently squeezed the wound, allowing a drop of blood to precisely fall on the center of the puppet’s forehead, where there was an almost indistinguishable shallow indentation.
The blood was absorbed by the runes on the puppet’s surface at a speed visible to the naked eye, like a desert devouring rain, quickly disappearing without a trace.
Once fully absorbed, the puppet seemed to emit a faint buzzing sound, akin to a sigh from afar.
Moments later, those originally dim runes began to flicker with a weak red glow.
On and off, like a heartbeat, bestowing this inanimate object with an almost lifelike quality.
As he infused magic power, the puppet began to inflate rapidly like a balloon.
"Next is the introduction of consciousness..."
Ron watched as the bizarre puppet quickly grew to a size comparable to his own, furrowing his brows as he reached out to touch its forehead.
An icy sensation immediately came over him, a coldness that felt not just physical, but a void existing on a spiritual level.
However, as the contact continued, this cold sensation gradually gave way to a feeling of familiarity, as if touching a long-lost fragment of himself.
Ron closed his eyes and began trying to infuse a portion of consciousness into the puppet through his fingertips.
As the infusion increased, he began to feel a subtle resistance and discomfort, like a cup nearing overflowing, where each additional drop becomes difficult to add.
"Indeed, it’s not an affinity issue but a capacity limitation."
Just as Hayek mentioned, there is indeed a limit to the amount of consciousness that can be infused into the Stand-In Puppet.
Too little infusion will not establish effective control;
Too much infusion will negatively impact the main body, like a piece of paper torn in half, each half unable to fulfill its original function.
This limitation is likely the main reason why even Official Wizards find it challenging to effectively utilize this treasure.
Ron carefully adjusted the amount of infusion, his precision in spiritual control far exceeding that of ordinary individuals.
With a portion of consciousness successfully infused, he suddenly felt a peculiar sense of "splitting," as if an invisible blade had cleaved him into two.
[Stand-In Puppet activated successfully!]
[Current Energy: 0/100%]
[Effect: Creates a duplicate that shares some abilities with the user, current state is ordinary simulation]
[Maximum Distance: 100 meters]
[Trait: Dual Consciousness (the user can simultaneously control both the main body and the duplicate)]
Ron attempted to control the puppet’s movement, concentrating part of his attention to command it to raise its arm.
The puppet did move according to his will but with an extremely mechanical and rigid motion.
It was like a baby learning to walk or a rusty tin man, where every joint movement carried evident stiffness and delay.
"Controlling it is more difficult than I imagined."
A hint of dissatisfaction flashed in Ron’s eyes, but he quickly regained his composure.
He could feel that the portion of consciousness he split off could control the puppet, but the effect was far less flexible and natural than controlling his main body.
"This should be what Hayek referred to as the ’Dual Tasking’ problem."
Ron suddenly realized and understood the vice dean’s warning.
For ordinary apprentices, this kind of split control is truly a daunting challenge to overcome.
Without sufficiently strong spiritual power and consciousness control ability, it’s difficult to manage two bodies simultaneously without encountering severe coordination issues.
Those who attempted this likely mostly ended in failure, possibly even suffering injuries from excessive mental fatigue.
However, thanks to his "Dual Soul" talent, Ron had a significant advantage in this regard over ordinary apprentices.
"The state of the Stand-In Puppet is just a high simulation, not a real body."
Through a series of meticulous experiments, Ron gradually understood the essence and operational mechanism of the puppet.
The puppet doesn’t simply split the user’s consciousness into two but operates under a "transmission-replication" mechanism.
The user must consume a large amount of magic power to transmit their own information to the puppet.
The puppet then undergoes a certain degree of high-level replication, generating movements and abilities similar to the main body.
The problem is that this replication can never be perfect, as there will always be a certain amount of information loss and delay.
This also explains why the puppet, although able to simulate the user’s abilities, always shows a drastically reduced effect as if a damper were in place.
"In this way, my imagined double cultivation effect cannot be achieved for now."
Ron thought with some disappointment.
He originally hoped to cultivate through both his main body and stand-in simultaneously, thereby gaining double the progress.
But it now seems that the puppet’s state is more like a remote-controlled robot, though more flexible than simple remote control, still unable to achieve a true "Dual Body Cultivation" effect.

chapters.title: Chapter 239 - 169: His "Gaze" (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 239: Chapter 169: His "Gaze" (3)
Information flows in one direction; the puppet cannot transmit its own experiences and insights back to the main body.
At the same time, this also means that the plan he envisioned, where the stand-in takes on the risks of the Demon Hunter path while the main body enjoys the benefits, cannot be realized for the time being.
The transformation into a Demon Hunter requires real physical change, not just surface simulation.
He checks the panel information again:
[Note: Once the charge reaches 50%, the "Deep Binding" function can be unlocked, enabling two-way information transmission between the stand-in and the main body]
"This might solve the current issue."
Ron pondered, a gleam in his eyes:
"If the puppet can transmit its status back to the main body, then the concept of ’Dual Body Cultivation’ and ’unidirectional risk bearing’ could possibly be realized."
But right now, the puppet has no charge at all; there’s still a long way to go before reaching 50%.
Previously, he had inquired with the Transformer, realizing that the high concentration of Magic Power contained in Magic Stones is actually applicable to all ’rare antiquities.’
But now the workshop has just gotten on track, and his stock of Magic Stones isn’t plentiful.
Having tested several times before, a complete Magic Stone only replenished 1%, so he planned to use it for the recording ability of the "Thousand Transformations."
The charging of this "Stand-In Puppet" will have to wait a bit longer.
Thinking of this, Ron continued with several sets of precise experiments, testing various capability boundaries of the puppet.
"As an initial state, this is already quite good."
He concluded: "Despite numerous limitations, the tactical value of the Stand-In Puppet is not to be underestimated."
In combat, a stand-in capable of sharing damage and performing auxiliary tasks would undoubtedly greatly enhance his survivability and tactical flexibility.
Using the puppet to scout, distract enemies, implement a feint strategy, or acting as a scapegoat in times of crisis — these are all highly practical tactical applications.
Most importantly, this Abyssal Treasure indeed has a good compatibility with his "Dual Soul" talent, with an effect far exceeding Hayek’s described ’mechanical rigidity.’
But to truly leverage more roles from the puppet, Ron knows what he needs to do: Break through to the Advanced Apprentice stage to gain stronger Spiritual Power.
Only when Spiritual Power reaches a sufficiently powerful level can one better control such complex states of divided consciousness.
Making two bodies work seamlessly, unlike the current barely maintained situation.
"A breakthrough is imperative."
Ron withdrew his spirit from the experiments, retracting the consciousness infused into the puppet.
The puppet’s movements immediately stopped, becoming like a marionette with cut strings; the light in its eyes faded, returning to a static, sealed state.
But a subtle connection has already been established.
He carefully placed the puppet, reduced in size after losing its Magic Power, back into the Black Ebony Box, ensuring the seal remained intact to prevent any energy leakage.
Then he proceeded to the preparation room to check the various auxiliary Magic Potions Lilia had already prepared.
The Magic Potion Bottles were neatly arranged on the shelf, each labeled with detailed tags showing the formula, effects, and applicable scenarios.
The "Awakening" and "Spiritual Shield" potions were particularly conspicuous, emitting faint blue and golden glows, quietly waiting for the moment of use.
"Let’s begin the full sprint."
Ron looked at the Magic Potions prepared for the breakthrough, his eyes filled with a complex mix of anticipation and caution.
The breakthrough in Meditation Technique typically comes with risks.
The transition of Spiritual Power from quantitative to qualitative is like the moment a kettle is about to boil, both the critical point and the most unstable state.
A minor misstep could lead to total failure, or even irreversible mental damage.
Moreover, Lady Allen had previously warned him:
"Inspiration is both an opportunity and a danger. Many outstanding wizard seeds have lost themselves at this juncture."
Quite unfortunately, he is precisely the kind blessed with high inspiration.
Ron exhaled deeply, his gaze resting on the auxiliary Magic Potions, as if confirming the final safety measures.
He picked up the first Magic Potion, the "Amber Thought Liquid," which can temporarily dispel distractions and enhance mental concentration, aiding the user in quickly entering the state and reducing external interference.
He carefully pulled out the cork, and the potion immediately emitted a faint scent of grass, like the first breath of dawn’s breeze.
Ron drank it all in one go, allowing the liquid to slide into his body.
Almost immediately, he felt a refreshing sensation spreading from his throat to his entire body, like a clear stream washing over each cell.
The thoughts that usually emerged endlessly, like fog blown away by the wind, left only pure thinking and focus.
Next, he picked up the second bottle, the "Spiritual Amplification Liquid," which can temporarily increase the activeness of Spiritual Power.
However, the side effect is mild headache after ingestion, and excessive use may even lead to transient hallucinations.
He cautiously took a medium dose, avoiding any potential incident due to over-stimulation.
The slightly spicy liquid slid into his abdomen, spreading like a ball of fire within his body.
He could feel his Spiritual Power being injected with a powerful vitality, becoming more acute.
Finally, he consumed the third "Spiritual Shield" potion, the final insurance measure, specifically intended to resist potential high-intensity Spiritual Contamination.
With the preparations complete, Ron sat cross-legged.
As his body relaxed, his consciousness began to detach from the perception of the physical world, gradually sinking into that familiar state of Meditation.

chapters.title: Chapter 240 - 169: His "Gaze" (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 240: Chapter 169: His "Gaze" (4)
As consciousness delved deeper, his spiritual world unfolded slowly, like an endless star map.
Complex star track runes naturally formed in the consciousness space, like a precise cosmic model.
Each node emitted a faint and steady glow, connecting with each other to form a complete and harmonious whole.
This is the core structure of the "Star Eater’s Ravings." After long-term cultivation, Ron could easily construct this complex model and maintain its stable operation.
Compared to its initial fragile and shaky state, the current rune structure was solid and flexible, accommodating more spiritual power flow.
His spiritual power flowed along the rune trajectories, like streams in a galaxy, forming a perfect cycle.
Each cycle brought him a deeper understanding of the universe and the essence of spiritual power, as if each loop was a small death and rebirth of thought.
Gradually, Ron felt his consciousness drifting away from the physical body, entering a broader space.
Surrounding him was the boundless cosmic starry sky, countless stars twinkling in the darkness.
They were no longer mere points of light, but living entities, each containing unique energy and information, as if myriad eyes were watching him, the intruder.
This wonderful experience was not the first time, but each time brought new sensations and insights.
The appearance of the starry sky seemed subtly different each time, like a living entity constantly changing, rather than a static backdrop.
"Today’s meditation state is very stable."
Ron silently recited in his heart, continuing to focus on the guidance and circulation of spiritual power.
According to past experience, he needed to persist in such deep meditation for a sufficient amount of time.
Time became extraordinarily slow and exceptionally long during meditation.
Ron did not know how much time had passed, perhaps minutes, perhaps hours.
In this state of deep meditation, the concept of time became extremely ambiguous, even completely disappearing.
He could only feel the flow and accumulation of spiritual power, that feeling was like a sponge slowly soaking up water, gradually becoming heavy and full.
["Star Eater’s Ravings" (Proficient) Experience Points + 1]
[Current Progress: "Star Eater’s Ravings" (Proficient 197/300)]
As long as a few more experience points were accumulated, he could complete the first stage of "Star Eater’s Ravings" cultivation and officially enter the realm of the Advanced Apprentice.
He concentrated even more, throwing himself wholly into meditation.
The flow of spiritual power along the rune trajectories accelerated, like water about to boil.
As spiritual power continued to accumulate, his sea of consciousness gradually became turbulent.
It was as if something was about to break through the surface.
That feeling was both exhilarating and terrifying, like standing on the edge of a cliff, fearing the fall yet yearning to fly.
["Star Eater’s Ravings" (Proficient) Experience Points + 1]
[Current Progress: "Star Eater’s Ravings" (Proficient 198/300)]
As the numbers approached the critical point, the stars in the surrounding starry sky seemed brighter.
Their light was no longer just a static flicker, but carried a certain rhythm, as if conveying some message to him.
It was an ancient and mysterious language, not expressed through sound, but through the interplay of light and shadow.
["Star Eater’s Ravings" (Proficient) Experience Points + 1]
[Current Progress: "Star Eater’s Ravings" (Proficient 199/300)]
The surge of spiritual power grew more intense, Ron felt an unprecedented pressure, as if the entire universe was compressing him, trying to crush him to dust.
The whole starry sky seemed to come alive, filled with an indescribable vitality.
The light of the stars flickered rapidly, like some mysterious drumbeats, vibrating Ron’s consciousness core.
This was the most dangerous yet precious part of the "Star Eater’s Ravings" — the "Apex" trait had been triggered.
[Inspiration has been triggered, please remain extremely cautious!]
The once orderly stars were suddenly stirred by an invisible giant hand, beginning to spin and move violently, forming a massive whirlpool.
Ron’s consciousness was drawn to this whirlpool, unconsciously drifting towards its depths.
The center of the whirlpool was a deep darkness, darker than the surrounding cosmos, as if it could devour all light.
The darkness suddenly moved, like the eyelids of some colossal creature lifting slowly.
A gigantic, indescribable "eye" opened within the darkness, staring straight at Ron.
It was not an eye understood by human concepts, more like an idea, a phenomenon, a high-dimensional entity.
It had no specific form, yet it emanated an overwhelming presence.
Unlike usual, this time the "eye" seemed truly to be looking at him, rather than aimlessly scanning.
That gaze contained an indescribable emotion, not anger, not curiosity, not indifference...
But a kind of... bewilderment?

chapters.title: Chapter 241 - 170: Dead Universe
chapters.content:
Chapter 241: Chapter 170: Dead Universe
At the moment Ron locked eyes with the gigantic "eye," an invisible force surged into his consciousness like a tide, instantly filling his Spiritual World.
Countless unfamiliar and complex pieces of information poured into his consciousness like floodwaters, each weighing enough to destroy a normal person’s sanity.
The first whisper of the universe’s birth, the folding rules between dimensions, the fundamental causes of time’s flow rate, the metamorphic process of galaxy sublimation...
These concepts, far beyond what human thinking could bear, were forcibly injected into Ron’s Spiritual World at that moment.
Each concept carried the weight of a mountain, oppressing his spiritual structure.
"True knowledge is a heavy burden," now he truly understood the meaning of this phrase.
Ron felt a severe headache, as if someone was drilling into his skull.
The Magic Potion’s Spiritual Shield effect was triggered, and a silver-blue Energy Barrier unfolded around his consciousness, blocking some of the information’s impact.
The barrier only held for a moment, but it was enough to slow the initial impact, giving Ron precious time to react.
"Too much... must... stabilize the Spiritual Force Field..."
Ron struggled to maintain the integrity of his thoughts, but the tidal wave of knowledge was too overwhelming, like a flood breaking through a dam, sweeping away the defenses of his consciousness space he had meticulously constructed.
Just as his spirit was about to collapse at the Critical Point, his consciousness was abruptly torn away.
The sensation was like being seized by an unimaginable giant hand, traversing dark tunnels that crisscross through the endless void, only to be casually discarded into a strange Starry Sky.
This Starry Sky was completely different from what he usually saw in Meditation.
Gone were the living stars flickering with the light of life, and the subtle order and beauty; there was only the deep dark background, nearly devouring everything.
Occasionally, a few flickers of light, like the weak heartbeat of a dying person.
The feeling this Starry Sky gave was like it was about to die...
Ron tried to sense the surroundings, only to find his Spiritual Power seemed trapped in some viscous substance, each extension becoming extraordinarily difficult.
"Where is this place, exactly?"
As soon as the question rose in his heart, he heard a strange vibration sound from above:
It was a sound belonging to no known creature, like countless metal plates rubbing against each other, piercing and evoking fear.
He alertly looked up, and an icy chill swept through every part of his body.
A tentacle so enormous it filled his entire field of vision gently trembled.
Its surface was covered with countless tiny suckers and scales, each flashing a sinister dark purple light.
Its vast size made it unimaginable who or what the main body of such an existence could be.
The tentacle trembled lightly, like shaking off an excess hair, shedding an object.
The object warped and twisted continually during its fall, like a perpetually reversing hourglass.
Ultimately, it landed not far in front of Ron, turning into a sea urchin-like creature covered entirely in spikes.
This creature was about three meters tall, jet black with spines emitting a ghostly blue light.
Surrounded by dozens of muscled, knotted tentacles constantly flailing, emitting an unpleasant moist sound.
It lacked obvious facial features, but Ron could feel a sense of pressure from being watched, as if every inch of the creature’s surface hid an invisible eye.
This was far from an ordinary Spiritual Contamination entity...
Common Spiritual Contamination often manifests as hallucinations or nightmares, but the aura emanating from this creature carried a tangible threat.
Ron’s heart sank, realizing the severity of the situation before him.
This was not a mere illusion or regular Spiritual Contamination but a real trial triggered by the "overmind" Trait.
"It seems this is the ’Insight is Curse’ that Lady Allen warned about..."
Ron analyzed calmly, his brows furrowed:
"Each burst of inspiration is a mix of opportunity and risk."
Instinct warned him: If he couldn’t defeat this creature, he might be trapped forever in this Consciousness Space.
The creature seemed able to sense his thoughts, emitting a sound between a howl and a whisper.
The sound did not transmit through the air but directly echoed in Ron’s mind, carrying an indescribable decay.
In the next moment, dozens of tentacles attacked him simultaneously, their speed nearly leaving afterimages, clearly not intending to give him any time to think.
Ron’s combat intuition triggered instantly.
He did not panic; his expression hardly changed.
In such a life-or-death moment, he instead entered a nearly transcendental rational state.
Constructing the Magic Model was already merging into his instincts, and Spiritual Power flowed like water into every node with precision.
The model formed rapidly, nearly twice as fast as before, the result of long-term high-intensity training.
"Ring of Brilliance!"
A brilliant golden-red ring burst forth, like a miniature sun, driving the attacking tentacles back a few steps.
The heat radiating from the ring slightly warped the air, and the touch of light even caused minor scorch marks on the surfaces of those directly illuminated tentacles.
The creature emitted a piercing shriek, tentacles instinctively recoiling slightly but soon returning to an aggressive stance.
"The effect is minimal..."
Ron’s sharp eyes tracked the creature’s reactions, quickly calculating various possibilities in his mind:
"It has certain fears of Light and Heat Magic but is not entirely restrained."

chapters.title: Chapter 242 - 170: Dead Universe (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 242: Chapter 170: Dead Universe (Part 2)
The monster seemed to be evaluating Ron’s strength, keeping its tendrils temporarily at a distance, but then it changed its attack strategy.
Suddenly, dozens of tiny pores on its surface simultaneously sprayed out thick dark green liquid, forming a lethal mist that enveloped Ron.
The wide-ranging acid rain poured down, leaving him with no place to dodge, forcing him to activate his bloodline power.
The energy in his body instantly boiled, the Red Blood Flying Dragon’s power surging beneath his skin.
Soon, a layer of fine scales appeared, covering his surface skin.
At the same time, Ron harnessed his spiritual power, condensing the "Ring of Brilliance" into a tighter protective net, forming dual defenses.
This is the effect brought about by the additional trait "Light Flame Transformation," making the "Ring of Brilliance" more malleable.
The acid fell like rain, the first droplets contacting the Ring of Brilliance immediately hissed sharply, transforming into wisps of green steam dissipating in the air.
But the volume of liquid was too large, some of the acid broke through the ring and dripped on Ron’s scale defense.
"Hiss—" Ron gasped, feeling the sting of scales being corroded.
The corrosiveness of the liquid far exceeded his expectations, even with dragon scales as protection, he still felt a burning pain.
"This thing is more dangerous than I imagined." A trace of gravity flashed in Ron’s eyes.
After the initial probe, he had roughly gauged the opponent’s capabilities:
Formidable physical attacks, coupled with corrosive acid, and other attack methods seemingly unmanifested, this combination was chilling.
Moreover, the monster’s aura was far stronger than a Scorpion’s, more sinister, more ancient, more... not belonging to this world.
"Pure defense is not a long-term solution." Ron quickly adjusted his strategy, deciding to take the initiative.
He took a deep breath, focused his mind, and activated the [Boiling Blood] trait.
In an instant, a more frenzied stream of heat surged in his body, as if a volcano erupted in his veins.
Ron felt the power surging inside, his eyes gradually taking on the vertical pupil state unique to dragon species.
A touch on the waist, the familiar equipment was with him, also feeling the coverage of "Thousand Transformations."
This makes it easier...
He drew out the Ironwood Sword, using the "Light Flame Transformation" trait to wrap the "Ring of Brilliance" as a layer of golden-red light flame around the sword blade, striking the monster’s flank directly.
This strike fused physical attack with the triple might of light and fire, quite like the prototype of a "Magic Swordsman," where the sword light passed, the void twisted.
——Slash!
A soft sound, the sword blade sliced through the air, carrying a scorching wave, fiercely slashing the monster’s tendrils.
Several thick tendrils snapped in response, with dark green viscous liquid oozing from the break, writhing in mid-air before turning into dark particles and scattering.
"Effective!" Ron’s eyes brightened, slightly relieved.
At least confirming the thing isn’t completely invincible.
Seizing the moment, he maneuvered swiftly among the monster’s tendrils.
The sword blade like several golden-red bolts of lightning, each strike precisely hitting the monster’s weak spot.
In mere tens of seconds, he had severed nearly half of the monster’s tendrils.
The monster emitted a howl between lament and rage, trembling violently.
But as Ron prepared to continue his attack, an anomaly arose...
The severed tendrils’ stumps rapidly grew new tissue visible to the naked eye, quickly forming new tendrils even thicker than before!
"High-speed regeneration and adaptability?" Ron slightly frowned, a trace of worry emerging in his heart.
The situation was more troublesome than he imagined.
The newborn tendrils not only returned to their original state but even became stronger.
The surface covering spines became denser, clearly adapting to his attack style.
The monster’s entire body began to swell violently, all the spines erecting simultaneously, radiating a ghostly blue glow.
Then like a rain of arrows, hundreds of sharp spines shot out in all directions, sealing off all of Ron’s escape routes.
Meanwhile, the remaining tendrils and new tendrils formed a giant net attacking from another direction, creating a perfect siege.
Ron frowned, rapidly calculating the possible breakthrough.
His spiritual power focused to an unprecedented degree, the spirit wave burst formed instantly.
"Spiritual Interference!"
An invisible ripple was released by him, accurately hitting the tentacle monster that barely moved.
The effect was immediate.
The tendrils lost coordination under the influence of spiritual interference, twitching erratically, creating a possible escape route for him.
At the same time, Ron’s body twisted at nearly impossible angles, trying to evade most of the incoming spines.
The Ring of Brilliance was also expanded to its maximum range, forming a flickering light flame barrier, attempting to intercept some of the incoming spines.
However, the number of spines was too many, and their speed astonishingly fast.
Even with scale protection and ring defense, several spines pierced through the line, stabbing fiercely into his shoulder, arms, and thighs.
"Hiss—" The severe pain came instantly, Ron felt a dizziness, as if toxins were spreading within.
Not good, a thought flashed in his mind: These spines likely carried toxins that can paralyze or weaken spiritual power.
"Must remove them quickly."
Ron endured the pain, quickly guiding the bloodline power to the wound.
Meanwhile, muscles exerted force, the spines on his body were quickly squeezed out, each extrusion felt a tearing-like pain.

chapters.title: Chapter 243 - 170: Dead Universe_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 243: Chapter 170: Dead Universe_3
The [Boiling Blood] trait accelerated blood circulation, but at this moment, it was having the opposite effect, making the toxin work faster.
Though the battle was within the Consciousness Space, the damage primarily on a mental level, the pain and weakness felt very real.
Even though he relied on willpower to force himself through, Ron still felt a wave of helplessness sweeping over him.
The operation of his Spiritual Power became sluggish, and the construction of the Magic Model was no longer as smooth as before.
The monster seemed to sense his weakness, emitting a nearly triumphant hiss.
Immediately, the tightly sealed center of its body suddenly split open, revealing a giant mouth filled with sharp teeth.
Within the giant mouth, there was no tongue, only a mass of wriggling black substance, resembling some sort of liquid shadow.
The giant mouth slowly opened and closed a few times, then emitted an inexplicably low raving sound.
It wasn’t a human language, not even the language of any creature, yet it inexplicably made sense in Ron’s mind:
"Zz... Krulu... Nyarg... Ralyth..."
This raving invaded Ron’s consciousness like a tangible force, each syllable carrying a powerful Spiritual Shock, directly disrupting his thought processes.
His once orderly thoughts suddenly became a chaotic mess, the Magic Model crumbled in his Spiritual Space, unable to maintain its complete structure.
"This is also a type of Spiritual Interference ability!"
Ron identified this mode of attack, a strong fear rising in his heart.
This form of attack was somewhat similar to the "Spiritual Shock" taught by Soron, but it was more primal, deeper, and more—twisted.
It not only interfered with the operation of Spiritual Power but also induced strong emotions of fear and despair.
Ron felt his will being eroded bit by bit.
Like waves continuously crashing against the beach, again and again, until the last grain of sand was swept into the sea.
"Must... stabilize..."
He clenched his teeth, striving to muster what remained of his conscious awareness, constructing a barrier of Spirit.
However, just as he attempted to stabilize his Spirit at a critical moment, the monster’s tentacles attacked again.
Spines deeply penetrated his scale defense, causing waves of tearing pain.
Ron faced the giant mouth filled with sharp teeth, so close he could feel the sour, rancid breath emanating from it.
The giant mouth opened, and a viscous acidic liquid sprayed out, right towards his face.
Ron instinctively strengthened the protection of the Ring of Brilliance, the golden-red light film forming a thin barrier before him.
The acid hit the light film, emitting a piercing hissing sound, most of it evaporating into green mist.
But a small amount seeped through the defense, landing on his skin, bringing intense burning pain.
"The situation is getting increasingly unfavorable..." Ron felt an unprecedented sense of urgency.
His every attack was offset by the opponent’s Regeneration Ability, and the prolonged battle consumed a vast amount of Spiritual Power;
The opponent’s acid and spines inflicted significant injuries on him, restricting his movements;
And the most troubling was those ravings, continuously disrupting his Spiritual Field, making it difficult for him to focus and cast spells.
This was far more troublesome than facing the Scorpion before.
At least the Scorpion had clear weaknesses and periods of fatigue, whereas this monster seemed tirelessly relentless, with more varied means of attack.
"I must break this situation!" Ron thought in pain.
His gaze swept over every detail of the monster, his mind racing for a potential breakthrough point.
"This thing’s Regeneration Ability is extraordinarily strong, physical attacks have limited effect... the range of the acidic spray is wide, difficult to dodge completely... and those ravings..."
At that moment, an inspiration suddenly flashed by.
——Those ravings, they seemed to be the core of the monster’s power.
Whenever it uttered those ravings, its Regeneration Ability became more vigorous, the power of its tentacles increased, as if those sounds themselves carried some form of power.
Recalling his recently advanced "Thousand Transformations" technique, a bold idea suddenly crossed Ron’s mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 244 - 171: Ravings
chapters.content:
Chapter 244: Chapter 171: Ravings
"Its ’record’ ability... perhaps it can..."
This was an adventure, you could even call it a gamble, but in the face of the current predicament, Ron had no choice.
He temporarily lifted the "Boiling Blood" state, even deliberately weakening his actions, allowing the monster to pull him closer.
Close proximity was a prerequisite for the "record" ability, and it had to be face-to-face. It was a risky move, but if it succeeded...
The monster seemed to mistakenly think Ron had given up resisting and more recklessly pulled him toward its terrifying giant mouth.
When the distance shortened to less than three meters, the giant mouth opened and closed again, preparing to emit that deadly ravings.
Now is the moment! Ron’s heart stirred, and he instantly activated the record ability of Thousand Transformations.
[Record Activation]
[Target: Ravings]
The monster’s ravings arrived as expected, penetrating directly into Ron’s mind:
"Zzzz... Klu... Nyag... Rotp..."
This time, after mental resistance, he allowed Thousand Transformations to fully record the sound wave pattern and energy structure.
The mental pain remained, as if countless fine needles were piercing his brain at the same time, but Ron gritted his teeth and held on, waiting for the moment the record was completed.
[Record Completed]
[Release will consume 1% energy]
The opportunity has come! Ron immediately used Thousand Transformations to release the just-recorded ravings.
The sound wave, using his spiritual power as a medium, layered together, forming a peculiar resonance effect.
"Zzzz... Klu... Nyag... Rotp..."
The same ravings, emitted from Ron, surprisingly resonated with the monster.
The monster visibly froze, the active tentacles suddenly stiffened, as if receiving contradictory instructions.
Its giant mouth hung half-open, seemingly not expecting its weapon to be used by the enemy.
This brief chaos gave Ron a chance to catch his breath.
Through the dual-enhanced special vision of "Extraordinary Recognition" and "Insight," Ron observed the monster at close range, discovering an anomaly at the center of its body:
There seemed to be some kind of core hidden there, flickering with faint light as the ravings were emitted.
"Found it!" Ron’s spirits lifted, a hint of hope rising in his heart.
He immediately mobilized the remaining bloodline power inside his body.
[Boiling Blood] trait was activated again, the blood in his veins simmering like molten lava, providing him with one last surge of explosive strength.
At the same time, he condensed the "Ring of Brilliance" to its utmost, the golden-red flames on the sword blade becoming increasingly solid.
Ron precisely controlled the release direction and timing of the recorded ravings, creating a perfect reverse against the opponent’s ravings.
This phenomenon is called "destructive interference" — two completely opposite waveforms overlapping would cancel each other out, creating a zone of silence.
And during this brief moment of "silence," the monster’s energy field showed unprecedented chaos.
Its whole body trembled slightly, like a machine suddenly losing its control program.
This was the flaw Ron had been waiting for!
He suddenly exerted force, breaking free from the already slackened tentacle restraints, launching himself like an arrow from a bowstring.
The sword blade in his hand drew an arc, aimed directly at the core deep within the giant mouth.
—Dawn Cross·Overlimit!
With a low shout, he poured all his spiritual power and bloodline power into this final strike.
The brightness of the light flame instantly increased several folds, almost blindingly dazzling.
The sword blade, carrying light and fire, accurately sliced into the giant mouth, piercing through the mass of black matter, striking directly at the core.
"Buzz——"
A sound, akin to an explosion on a mental level, erupted in the consciousness space, and Ron felt a powerful recoil force send him flying backward.
He spun a few times in the air before steadying himself, immediately assuming a defensive posture, watching vigilantly for the monster’s reaction.
The monster let out a heartrending howl, all its tentacles and spikes trembling violently, spasming as if electrocuted.
A large amount of black liquid began to surge out of its giant mouth, and upon contacting the void, instantly evaporating into wisps of dark smoke.
Finally, as the core completely shattered, the monster’s entire body began to collapse, rapidly disintegrating from the center outward into countless dark particles, dissipating into the void.
Ron panted heavily, his spiritual power and bloodline power nearly exhausted, yet he remained in a highly alert stance.
With the complete disappearance of the monster, this dark starry sky also gradually faded, the light becoming softer, and the colors of the stars restoring their previous splendor.
The familiar consciousness space from meditation was re-forming, those stars running along specific trajectories reappearing.
"I... won?" He was somewhat incredulous, but then a wave of unprecedented accomplishment surged in his heart.
This wasn’t an ordinary battle; it was a true transcendence.
He defeated a powerful enemy in the most perilous environment, almost as if escaping death.
The satisfaction from this victory far surpassed any previous success.
A series of prompts appeared in his consciousness at this moment:
His consciousness, under such extreme pressure, seemed to undergo a wondrous qualitative change.
[Experience Points for "Star Eater’s Ravings" (Proficient) + 10]
[Current Progress: "Star Eater’s Ravings" (Proficient 209/300)]
[Absorbed special soul energy, Thousand Transformations charge + 10%]
[Current Progress: 24%/100%]
[New Record Ability: Ravings]
These prompts made Ron’s eyes light up.
He hadn’t expected the trial to not only bring an increase in meditation experience points but also charge for Thousand Transformations, and even record a new ability!

chapters.title: Chapter 245 - 171: Ravings_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 245: Chapter 171: Ravings_2
"Ravings... This is a pleasant surprise." Ron pondered the potential uses of this new ability.
If he could grasp and utilize that special sound wave, it might be of great use in combating Spiritual Element attacks.
His Spiritual Power was also thoroughly purified at this moment, becoming more pure and powerful.
The feeling was akin to a gentle stream suddenly turning into a surging river, the increase in power awe-inspiring, and it carried an unprecedented sense of harmony and stability.
[Spirit: 3.99→4.0]
[Power Level Increased: Intermediate Apprentice→Advanced Apprentice]
Ron let out a long breath, feeling both surprised and relieved.
This peculiar consciousness battle had elevated his Spiritual Power to the 4.0 standard line of an Advanced Apprentice.
"That ’eye’... that ’gaze’..."
Ron recalled that enormous, enigmatic eye filled with doubt, a special feeling rising in his heart.
He vaguely understood that he might have inadvertently attracted the attention of a great being.
And that battle could perhaps have been a trial, or maybe merely an incidental "observation" by that being.
"This is merely a glimpse of the whole..." Ron murmured to himself, filled with awe.
Such a great being, could it be the level that Lady Allen referred to as the "Third Stage?"
If so, his understanding of "truth" likely remained in its infancy.
Ron closed his eyes, feeling the Spiritual Power flowing within him.
This feeling was entirely different now, no longer merely perceiving external energy but actively influencing and altering the energy flow around him.
Spiritual Power circulated within him like a living entity, each flow bringing deeper comprehension and greater Control Power.
"Advanced Apprentice..."
This title not only signifies the enhancement of power but represents a substantial step towards deeper esoteric mysteries.
And this is just the beginning.
Ron gradually withdrew from his meditation state, his consciousness detaching from that starry sky and returning to the physical world.
When he opened his eyes, he found himself still seated cross-legged in the laboratory.
The Array around him remained stably operating, the faint glow from the Magic Crystal Lamp intertwining with the moonlight seeping through the window, creating a tranquil atmosphere.
Glancing at the moon’s position outside, Ron estimated he had been meditating for a full six hours.
Unbeknownst to him, most of the night had already passed.
Yet the gains from these six hours far exceeded those of several weeks of accumulation.
Ron slowly stood, stretching his body, which had stiffened somewhat from maintaining the same posture for so long.
He suddenly recalled Lady Allen’s words:
"Inspiration is both opportunity and danger."
These words now held a unique significance.
Clearly, he might be the most extraordinary among all those practicing this Meditation Technique.
After all, he possessed a soul from the Otherworld, and the inspiration it brought far surpassed that of ordinary people...
Ron walked to the window, gazing at the moonlight and stars outside:
"Since ’true knowledge’ inevitably accompanies ’burden,’ what I must do is continually strengthen myself until I can bear the deepest knowledge."
Ron took a deep breath and closed his eyes, feeling the Spiritual Power surging within him.
At the moment he became an Advanced Apprentice, a fundamental change seemed to have occurred in his connection with this world.
Spiritual Power was no longer passively perceiving external energy but actively influencing and altering the flow of Magic Power around him.
This sensation was akin to a person once locked in a cage observing the world, suddenly obtaining the Key to open the cage.
His thoughts involuntarily returned to Lady Allen’s dark room filled with the scent of herbs.
"Star Eater’s Ravings, fundamentally different from other Gem Level Meditation Techniques."
Lady Allen spoke at that time, gently closing that ancient Scroll, her voice low and mysterious:
"It is not merely a cultivation tool; rather, it is like a bridge connecting mortals to those ancient and great entities. Every wizard truly mastering it has been ’gazed upon’ by ’them.’
"Many ancient texts have recorded that the true wizard’s path is to emulate those great entities, gradually understanding and approaching their essence."
Her emerald green eyes stared straight at Ron, seemingly able to pierce the soul:
"And Star Eater’s Ravings is one of the few Keys able to open that door."
Ron still remembered his query at that time: "So dangers after the first stage not only come from Spiritual Contamination?"
Lady Allen merely smiled mysteriously:
"If an ant suddenly gained the ability to understand human speech, do you think it could bear it? To mortals, the ’gaze’ of those great entities is both supreme honor and an extremely dangerous plight."
This conversation echoed repeatedly in Ron’s mind, intertwining with fragments from a book he once casually browsed in the School Library, "On the Origins of Wizards".
There was a passage in that book that left a deep impression on him:
"The first mystics were those gazed upon by the starry sky.
Therefore, they glimpsed truths incomprehensible to common people and attempted to collect and organize these passively obtained knowledge fragments through specific meditation methods...
Ron still remembered the characteristics described in the book of those ’watched’:
They often experienced a series of bizarre illusions and trials, often related to the stars, the Abyss, and ancient entities.
Those who successfully passed would undergo a qualitative breakthrough, while failures might forever sink into the Abyss of madness.

chapters.title: Chapter 246 - 171: Ravings_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 246: Chapter 171: Ravings_3
"This experience is by no means ordinary spiritual contamination or random hallucinations..."
Ron frowned:
"That perplexing ’gaze’, the trial formed by ’hair’ left behind... It’s all too deliberate."
A bolder conjecture formed in his heart:
Maybe the essence of the Star Eater’s Ravings Meditation Technique is a way to gradually be recognized by ’Them’?
And each burst of inspiration and trial is a step towards that ultimate goal?
Meditation is not the purpose, but a means;
The real purpose is to emulate those great beings, gradually understand and approach their essence, and even... transform into them?
"If it’s really the case..." Ron’s eyes became complex and profound:
"Then what am I truly pursuing? What lies at the end of this path?"
While pondering, sharp pain suddenly exploded from his temples, as though a red-hot steel needle pierced into his brain.
Immediately followed by an indescribable pressure, his entire head felt like it was being brutally crushed by an invisible hand.
The fragments of scattered knowledge in his mind began to collide irregularly, producing intense mental anguish.
A familiar chill rose from his spine, Ron felt he was tightly bound by a python.
"Spiritual contamination..." He immediately realized the issue at hand; the recent consciousness battle and breakthrough brought quite severe spiritual contamination.
Moreover, the intensity of this contamination far exceeded any previous occurrence—if not dealt with promptly, it could cause irreversible damage.
Ron endured the discomfort and swiftly grabbed the "Wake" potion from the table, uncorked it, and drank it down.
As the potion went down his throat, a cool sensation spread through his body, like a clear mountain spring dispersing the chaotic thoughts.
[Spiritual contamination has been temporarily suppressed, current contamination level: approaching moderate]
The potion took effect, but Ron knew it was only temporary suppression, not complete eradication.
He must address it immediately; otherwise, prolonged accumulation would lead to unimaginable consequences.
He realized he needed to act right away.
He retrieved the Silver Pocket Watch from his waist, the most reliable safeguard.
His fingertip lightly grazed the surface of the black gemstone, which immediately glowed with a strange red light, seemingly sensing its owner’s intent, and the faint sound of the internal gears’ movement became clearly audible.
[Detecting spiritual contamination, proceed with reset?]
"Begin reset." Ron commanded without hesitation.
The black gemstone on the pocket watch surface shone brightly, the central gear symbol started spinning wildly.
A peculiar suction was released, directly acting on Ron’s spiritual world.
The spiritual contamination was extracted as if drawn by an invisible hand, continually being absorbed into the pocket watch.
The black gemstone gradually became turbid, like a crystal stained black by ink.
Ron felt unprecedented relief, as though shedding a burden carried for years.
The entire process lasted about several dozen seconds, much longer than the typical reset time.
He could feel the stubbornness of the spiritual contamination, like oil stains embedded deep in the skin, requiring repeated scrubbing to be thoroughly removed.
Once the last trace of contamination was drawn out, the watch’s light dimmed, returning to tranquility.
[Successfully reset negative state: spiritual contamination, energy - 10]
[Current energy quota: 20/30]
Ron exhaled deeply, feeling the regained clarity in his mind, akin to a clear sky after a storm.
Unlike other rare artifacts, the Time Guardian’s pocket watch indeed felt exceptionally unique in its mechanism.

chapters.title: Chapter 247 - 172: Z... Kulu... Nyagg... Rotip...
chapters.content:
Chapter 247: Chapter 172: Z... Kulu... Nyagg... Rotip...
The pocket watch is not truly "charged" in the conventional sense, but rather displays an "energy quota."
Once these quotas are exhausted, he doesn’t need to deliberately replenish them; they will automatically refresh to the maximum value at midnight.
Its energy mechanism is more akin to a "quota" system.
The role of the Sands of Time, however, is to expand the maximum energy quota of the pocket watch, rather than simply charge it.
This very trait makes the pocket watch the most stable and reliable among all his rare antiques.
"It seems the Sands of Time truly hold the key here..."
Ron thoughtfully caressed the surface of the pocket watch:
"If I can obtain more Sands of Time, increasing the maximum quota to a higher level, the potential of this glory legacy will be even more astounding."
He carefully put away the pocket watch, calmed his mind, and began to keenly feel the various changes after becoming an Advanced Apprentice.
Unlike the obscure sensation during the elementary apprentice stage and the faint perception during the middle apprentice stage, now he can perceive the surrounding magic flow with unprecedented clarity.
This feeling was like someone who could previously only observe the outside world through a murky window suddenly gaining a pair of glasses that could see every detail of the world.
Every energy fluctuation in the room, the faint magic remnants contained in the walls.
Even the fine magic particles floating in the air, clearly presented within his perception.
These details, which in the past required full concentration to barely perceive, can now be captured with just a thought.
The most significant change, however, occurred in his casting ability.
Ron could clearly feel that his mastery over the three skilled spells:
Sound Wave Vibration, Slime Splash, and Ring of Brilliance had already formed stable "thought circuits" in his spiritual sea.
This is just as described in The Apprentice’s Ladder:
"When an apprentice masters more than three spells and reaches a level of proficiency, these independent thought circuits begin to interweave, forming an organic whole. This is not just a numerical addition, but a qualitative leap."
Ron attempted to construct the magic model for "Sound Wave Vibration," and was surprised to find that the process, which originally took more than ten seconds, now required only a few seconds.
His spiritual power naturally flowed along the already formed thought circuits, like water rushing down a pre-dug channel, easily and efficiently.
In the past, constructing a magic model required repeatedly checking the precise position of each node and energy flow, with even a slight negligence possibly leading to the collapse of the entire model.
But now, this process has become almost instinctual, as natural as muscle memory.
"Is this the ’thought network’ mentioned in The Apprentice’s Ladder?"
Ron’s eyes sparkled with surprise and curiosity.
The Apprentice’s Ladder once described:
"Apprentices who meet the conditions to advance to Advanced Apprentices will form a complex ’thought network’ in their spiritual sea, with various magic models acting as nodes, interconnected and mutually supportive.
Once this network is formed, casting efficiency and success rate will greatly increase, while also laying the groundwork for mastering more advanced combined magic in the future.
The denser and more complete this network is, the higher the wizard’s talent is deemed to be.
Many great wizards formed exceptionally complex thought networks during their Advanced Apprentice stages, which laid a solid foundation for their future achievements."
This change is not only reflected in casting speed but also in the precision of magic control.
Ron discovered that he could more precisely control the amount and direction of magic output, like evolving from a brute who only knows how to swing with all his might to a sword master proficient in controlling force.
Besides these standard changes, Ron noticed a unique phenomenon—even after only hearing a few instances of the "ravings," these syllables left an indelible mark in his mind.
During that consciousness battle, to counter the raving attacks of the sea urchin monster, he had to meticulously analyze and record those peculiar syllables.
This process made him realize that the ravings were not meaningless sounds, but had a specific structure and intrinsic logic as spiritual waves.
"’Zi... Klu... Niag... Rotip...’ These syllables seem to contain some grammatical structure..."
Whenever Ron slightly recalled, he could accurately recall the arrangement patterns of those syllables:
Whenever the sea urchin monster uttered the syllable "Zi", he felt a specific frequency of stinging in his spiritual defenses;
While "Klu" brought a sense of distortion, as if his spiritual power was forcibly stretched;
"Niag" induced a kind of dizziness, as if being swept into a whirlpool;
As for "Rotip", it produced an illusion, allowing him to briefly see some nonexistent scenes.
These effects were not mere spiritual interference but were unique rules of spiritual power manipulation techniques.
Especially when the Thousand Transformations recorded and reflected the ravings, causing marked interference to the sea urchin monster, it further convinced him that these ravings were indeed a substantive energy transmission method.
"If I could integrate the traits of the ravings into the Sound Wave Vibration..."
Ron internally mused, a trace of excitement flashing in his eyes:
"Perhaps a brand new, more penetrating attack method could be created."
The conventional Sound Wave Vibration mainly relies on physical vibrations to damage the target, like an invisible hammer fiercely striking the target’s physical structure, causing damage externally.
However, the ravings seemingly could act directly on the opponent’s spiritual level, bypassing physical defenses, and directly disturbing the core.

chapters.title: Chapter 248: 172: Z... Kulu... Nyagg... Rotip..._2
chapters.content:
Chapter 248: Chapter 172: Z... Kulu... Nyagg... Rotip..._2
If the two could be combined to create a compound attack that causes both physical vibration and mental impact, its power would far exceed a simple sound wave vibration.
Ron began to construct the prototype of this new magic in his mind.
He attempted to use the basic structure of sound wave vibration as a carrier, then integrated the specific frequency and fluctuation patterns of the ravings within it.
This process was extremely complex, like merging two completely different languages into a brand-new mode of communication.
But with the support of the Thought Network, this attempt no longer seemed as inconceivable as it once did.
"Perhaps this is my first step towards specialized magic."
Ron’s gaze was resolute, his heart filled with anticipation.
For an Advanced Apprentice to be promoted to an Official Wizard, they must have at least one completely specialized personal magic.
And right now, he seemed to have found a highly potential direction:
The fusion of raving traits into sound wave magic could perhaps become his signature ability.
Ron sat quietly at his workbench, beginning to meticulously record his understanding of the ravings and the concept of the new magic.
As he continually conceptualized its specific prototype in his consciousness, a whole new possibility was unfolding.
That was his own, unique magic system.
"The Star Eater’s Ravings is indeed a double-edged sword."
He mused to himself, "It brings both danger and opportunity."
This perfectly echoed the saying: "True knowledge is a heavy burden, and wisdom often accompanies madness."
Human cognition is so fragile; a gaze from a great being is enough to bring profound influence.
So, as he delves deeper into the Star Eater’s Ravings, what more awaits him?
Ron’s gaze drifted out the window, where the starry sky was shrouded in Black Mist Jungle, faintly visible.
In that infinitely deep universe, perhaps those ancient beings are watching this world, watching him.
And he’s only just beginning to understand the meaning of such a gaze.
.........
In the laboratory, Ron picked up the soul steel once more.
The crystal lattice structure, energy flow paths, and even the distribution of trace elements within the metal were vividly presented in his perception.
"Alchemist..." he thought of his recent completion of the Two Stars profession.
An Alchemist can create various alchemy items.
More importantly, their understanding of the essence of matter surpasses ordinary people, allowing for deeper material transformation and energy conversion.
Especially the special bonus of "greatly enhanced material perception ability."
This allowed him to intuitively perceive the internal structure and traits of matter, critically aiding in the creation of advanced alchemy items and the improvement of existing formulas.
To further test this, Ron took out a regular piece of iron to attempt an alchemy transformation.
He infused his spiritual power into the iron piece, guiding the rearrangement of its internal molecules.
With the assistance of the "Material Refining" skill, this process became exceptionally intuitive and easy, like molding a piece of soft clay with his hands.
The originally hard iron piece gradually became flexible under his guidance, while maintaining the strength of the metal.
Moreover, this transformation did not consume much energy; the entire process was efficient and precise, with almost no energy loss.
"The synergetic effects are even more powerful than I imagined."
Ron looked at the perfectly transformed metal in his hand, somewhat awestruck:
"This efficiency and precision are a qualitative leap."
Ron picked up the soul steel again, feeling the temperature and rhythm in his hand.
The soul steel had perfectly bonded with him, the Soul Seal Ceremony successfully imprinting his unique spiritual mark within the metal.
This meant that the magic sword forged from this soul steel would have unprecedented affinity and stability, making it the ideal vessel for realizing the Melting Furnace Concept.
Now, armed with the Alchemist skills and the synergy of "Material Refining," he had greater confidence in crafting the magic sword.
The complex processes that seemed nearly unattainable before now appeared to be within reach.
Ron turned to the workbench, beginning to draft a detailed design of the magic sword.
Under the enhancement of the Alchemist’s skills, his conceptualization ability reached a new peak.
What might have taken weeks in the past to complete such a complex design could now be refined to an astonishing degree in just a few days.
"Furnace Sword..." Ron wrote this name at the top of the design, his eyes gleaming with anticipation.
This sword would be more than just a weapon; it would be a miraculous furnace capable of purifying spiritual contamination and converting it into pure power.
Of course, there was one more crucial aspect:
It was an essential tool in reaching that higher level, the key to realizing the Melting Furnace Concept.
"Time will prove everything."
Ron stood up, walked to the window, and gazed out at the Black Mist Jungle outside.
"The quarterly evaluation meeting is in a month, determining who will ultimately win a spot at the bloodline altar..."
His gaze deepened as he began to calculate his next plans and preparations.
The quarterly evaluation meeting was vital, and he already had a complete plan:
Apply for Advanced Apprentice certification in half a month, while simultaneously certifying as a Bloodline Modifier, aiming to break into the top five sequences and strive for the key spot.
"Firstly, I need to sort out the current resources and tasks."
He began systematically listing the upcoming plans in the Library of Consciousness:
1. Trish’s Natural Affinity Magic Potion Refining (High Priority, Promised Commitment)
2. Advanced Apprentice Certification Preparation (To be completed within two weeks)

chapters.title: Chapter 249: 172: Zi... Kuru... Nyagg... Lotipu..._3
chapters.content:
Chapter 249: Chapter 172: Zi... Kuru... Nyagg... Lotipu..._3
3. Bloodline Modulator Certification (conducted simultaneously with Advanced Apprentice Certification)
4. Soul Steel Magic Sword Sketch Creation (ongoing)
5. Stand-In Puppet and Melting Furnace Concept Practice (ongoing)
6. Selection of Precious Ancient Books (whenever there is time)
The plan is clear, and the next step is to execute it in an orderly manner.
Just as he was about to start the first task, a gentle knock on the door echoed.
"Teacher, breakfast is ready."
Lilia’s gentle voice came from outside the door.
Ron smiled slightly. Over this period, Lilia had unknowingly become an indispensable part of the workshop.
She not only demonstrated remarkable talent in Magic Potion Making, but also meticulously and considerately managed the workshop’s daily chores with great orderliness.
From material procurement to tool cleaning, from workshop environment maintenance to paperwork organization.
These trivial tasks, which once consumed a lot of Ron’s time, have now been efficiently taken over by her.
The most commendable thing is that she has also established a comprehensive material classification and record system, making the workshop operate more smoothly.
Ron opened the door; Lilia was standing outside holding a delicate tray, on which there was a steaming cup of herbal tea and several perfectly shaped pastries.
"Teacher looks quite spirited."
Lilia said with a smile, handing the tray to Ron:
"I noticed that several critical materials in the warehouse are running low. I plan to go to the market for procurement this morning. Is there anything special you need?"
"Indeed, there are a few things."
Ron took the tray and pulled a list out of his pocket:
"These are the materials needed for Trish’s Natural Affinity Potion. Some are quite rare and may require visiting a few specific shops."
Lilia took the list, carefully read it, and nodded:
"I know where to buy Moon Orchid and Starlight Flower. As for the Forest Elf Tree Bark..."
She furrowed her brows, pondered for a moment, then regained her confident expression:
"I saw it last time at Kemp Shop, and it should be available."
Ron felt gratified by her increasingly adept professional proficiency:
"It seems you’re more familiar with the market than I am now."
"That’s thanks to your excellent guidance, Teacher."
Lilia said modestly, her face flushing faintly:
"I just try my best to remember each procurement experience in hopes of saving you more time."
Ron nodded: "You’re doing very well. By the way, also keep an eye out for any ’Star Crystal Sand,’ a special alchemy material that’s relatively rare."
"I will certainly keep an eye out." Lilia solemnly nodded, keeping this request in mind.
After seeing Lilia off, Ron began inspecting his Magic Sword design drawings.
In his conception, this "Furnace Sword" would be one of his most important power carriers.
But now, he must first fulfill the promise he made to Trish, after all, he had agreed long ago.
Ron walked to the dedicated Magic Potion work area and began preparing to refine the first batch of Natural Affinity Potions.
The formula provided by Trish was indeed precious—just seeing those complex proportions and unique refining requirements made it clear why this potion was considered a rarity.
The formula not only included conventional plant materials but also required several rare Natural Element crystals and Fairy creature essences.
For ordinary alchemists, such a formula would practically be an insurmountable chasm.
Just the precise control over those highly volatile Fairy essences would be enough to deter most alchemists.
But Ron certainly wasn’t an ordinary alchemist.
He habitually arranged various materials in exact order of use, ready to follow the familiar refining process step by step.
However, just as he was about to start, he suddenly realized that he had recently acquired the new skill "Material Transmutation."
"Perhaps it’s time to try a new approach in Magic Potion Refining. I’ve been so busy with other things that I almost forgot."
Ron took a deep breath, began activating the new Perception Ability within him, and focused his attention on the materials in front of him.
In an instant, it was as if a whole new world unfolded before his eyes.
The microscopic structure of each material, the flow trajectory of Energy in each wisp, and the interactions between each molecule—all presented themselves in a peculiar way within his perception.
"This is the true power of ’Material Transmutation...’"
Ron marveled internally, attempting to guide the Magic Potion Refining process in a completely new way.
The first step was processing the Moon Orchid.
Previously, he had to extract its essence with strict cutting methods and time windows, carefully operating the entire process for at least half an hour with full concentration.
But now, with just a gentle thought, he could sense the Energy Nodes inside the Moon Orchid.
His fingers, almost instinctively, gently pressed at specific locations, allowing a silver luminescence to effortlessly flow into the prepared container.
The entire process took less than five minutes, with efficiency increased by several times, and the purity of the extracted Moon Orchid essence far exceeded previous levels.
The same miracle occurred in each subsequent step.
In traditional refining, the most challenging Forest Elf Tree Bark required extremely complex preliminary processing and slow Energy guidance in ordinary Magic Potion refining.
The slightest mistake would cause a disruption in its Natural Elements, ruining the entire potion.
But now, Ron could directly "see" the energy network inside the bark, allowing the connection of stable links between different materials.
Three hours later, when the first bottle of Natural Affinity Potion was successfully completed, Ron couldn’t help but feel a little dazed.
Not only had the entire refining process more than doubled in speed, but the quality of the final product was also a delightful surprise.
The Magic Potion in the bottle displayed an almost transparent green hue, with fine specks of light drifting like fireflies within, emitting a fresh, vital aroma.
Its purity and stability far surpassed the standards the formula itself could achieve.
"This isn’t just a quantitative improvement, but a qualitative leap."
Ron carefully sealed the potion, contemplating the significant changes brought by this new ability.
"Material Transmutation," as a fusion of Magic Potion Making and Alchemy, not only inherited the strengths of both but also achieved a fundamental breakthrough on a technical level.
In past Magic Potion Refining, regardless of how refined the technique, it essentially remained an "external guidance."
Alchemists used Spiritual Power and techniques to guide materials to transform according to preset directions.
But now, "Material Transmutation" was an "internal resonance"—the Traits and potential of the materials themselves were directly awakened and guided, resulting in a more natural and harmonious Energy fusion.
It’s like transitioning from forcing materials to comply to having a dialogue with them, leading to natural improvements in efficiency and quality.
"With such high quality, perhaps I should ask Trish for an extra fee... hehe."
Just as Ron was reveling in awe of his new ability, Lilia returned with a basket full of materials, her face full of joy.
"Teacher, I have procured all the materials on the list!"
She exclaimed excitedly, carefully placing the basket on the table:
"Also, I found a newly opened material shop where they had the Star Crystal Sand you mentioned. I bought a small bag."
Ron raised his eyebrows in surprise: "Star Crystal Sand? Usually, that material is hard to come by. You’re quite lucky."
"Not entirely luck." Lilia explained proudly:
"Following the method you taught, I observed several shop owners’ supply channels and found that the owner of this new shop seems to have a background related to the Dwarf City-States, specializing in rare materials."
She retrieved a carefully wrapped small bag from the depths of the basket:
"They asked for a hefty price, but using your bargaining techniques, I successfully cut off about thirty percent of the price."
Ron took the bag, sensing the unique Energy Fluctuation inside—indeed, it was of high-purity Star Crystal Sand.
This material is crucial for the forging of the Magic Sword, enhancing the affinity between metal and Magic Power.
"Well done, Lilia." He genuinely praised, "Your procurement skills are now fully independent."
Embarrassed by the compliment, Lilia hastily changed the topic:
"I just followed your instructions. By the way, I saw you finished a potion. Was the progress smooth?"
She curiously looked at the potion:
"It seems very pure, much better than the samples I saw in Basic Magic Potion Theory books."
Ron didn’t respond to this, only suggesting that Lilia take some time to check on the ancient tree in the yard.
